name: Split Squat
steps: Stand with one foot forward and the other behind you, resting on its toes, with room between your feet for balance.
Brace your core, keep your torso upright, and bend both knees to lower your rear knee straight down toward the floor.
Stop just above the floor or earlier if you cannot keep your front foot planted.
Drive firmly through your front foot to stand back up, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep your feet hip-width apart laterally so you stay balanced instead of standing on a single narrow line.
Track your front knee straight over your toes without letting it cave inward.
